fact: Cabinet Secretary William Kabogo Gitau cited more than 22,500 services available through eCitizen.
The Draft 2026 Budget Policy Statement, as quoted, says over 17,668 services from over 350 agencies were onboarded onto eCitizen, and the article says it now provides more than 22,000 services.
ICT Authority Kenya says its Applications Department provides one-stop-shop platforms for government services to citizens and businesses.
